verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Funnels report that measures conversion through a series of events. It markets finding "critical drop-off points," and Session Replay lets users explore why customers drop off. Self-serve use is supported by its point-and-click interactive reports, natural-language funnel queries, and a community account of PMs building their own reports quickly. missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of per-step conversion/drop-off breakdowns in funnels, independent hands-on corroboration specific to funnel drop-off analysis by non-analysts.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer "which activation step loses users?" myself with funnels and drop-off analysis, without an analyst

citations.quote: Measure conversions through a series of events
Discover critical drop-off points and calibrate user journeys to optimize every touchpoint
analyze this data with interactive reports that let you query and visualize the results with just a few clicks
Now, with Mixpanel Session Replay, you can quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off.
you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
I've seen PMs spend hours in mixpanel quickly generating custom report after custom report.
